findings.F1: The book lost because it was short a rising market, not because of timing: it was short on 99.2 % of bars with a mean allocation of -1.17, its mean daily return was -0.19 % against +0.12 % for holding the coins, and the idea's unusual move of +0.13 % per case is only 0.7 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade.
findings.F2: Large 3-day rises continue rather than give back: on the non-overlapping 18-bar grid, bars whose 18-bar return is 1 to 2 of the coin's usual 18-bar moves are followed by an unusual 18-bar move of +0.141 usual moves (t 3.19, 573 cases), and the top decile of the 18-bar return by +0.160 (t 3.13, 530 cases). Five of six coins are positive, BTC +0.223 (t 2.42) and ZEC +0.245 (t 2.43), and XMR is flat at +0.001.
findings.F3: Among those large 3-day rises (more than 1 usual move), the third with the highest 18-bar volume against its 180-bar median is followed by +0.217 usual moves (t 2.64, 255 cases), against +0.119 (t 1.74) for the lowest-volume third, so rising volume rather than fading volume goes with the larger move up.
findings.F4: A bar whose volume is far above the coin's 30-day median volume (top decile of log volume over its 180-bar median) is followed by an unusual 18-bar move of +0.180 usual moves (t 3.33, 530 cases), against -0.079 (t -2.03) for the lowest-volume decile.
findings.F5: The 4-hour bar opening at 16:00 UTC is followed by a next-bar return of +0.050 standard deviations (t 6.71, 17506 bars), positive in all six coins (t 1.94 to 3.59) and in every year (2022 the weakest, +0.012, t 0.59).
findings.F6: Up-streaks of 3 or more bars show no give-back that depends on fading volume: with volume faded the unusual move is +0.041 (t 0.69, 261 cases), and with volume risen it is +0.090 (t 1.22, 286 cases). Both are in the up direction, which is the opposite of the tested idea.
findings.F7: Other calendar effects were not stable enough to count: the 20:00 UTC bar's next-bar return changes sign by year (2018 -0.139, t -4.98; 2024 +0.047, t 2.61), and Friday's +0.052 (t 6.31) is negative in 2022 (-0.030) and 2025 (-0.003).

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 3-day return against its usual 3-day move, and the higher its volume over those 3 days against its usual volume, the more the coin keeps moving the same way over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: After a strong 3-day rise on heavy volume, a trader should lean long or refuse a fade, since such rises tend to extend rather than give back.
ideas.name: volume-backed run continuation

ideas.idea: The further a coin's 4-hour volume rises above its usual volume over the past 30 days, the more the coin rises over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A volume surge is a reason to hold or take a long and to refuse a short over the following days.
ideas.name: volume surge precedes rise
